interface.name: case_subject_year
interface.meaning: Neutral roster of the persons and taxable years actually named in the case or query; it supplies no substantive legal fact.

interface.name: qualifying_child
interface.meaning: The child is a qualifying child of the claimant for the claimant's taxable year; the omitted section 152(c) tests are outside this module.

interface.name: qualifying_relative
interface.meaning: The relative is a qualifying relative of the claimant for the claimant's taxable year; the omitted section 152(d) tests are outside this module.

interface.name: section_152a_applies
interface.meaning: The section 152(a) dependent definition applies because the subject is the claimant's qualifying child or qualifying relative for the taxable year.

interface.name: dependent
interface.meaning: The subject is a dependent of the claimant for the claimant's taxable year.

interface.name: taxable_year_begins_in_calendar_year
interface.meaning: The person's specified taxable year begins in the specified calendar year.

interface.name: section_152b1_applies
interface.meaning: Section 152(b)(1) applies to an individual who is another claimant's dependent, for the individual's taxable year beginning in the same calendar year.

interface.name: section_151c_applies
interface.meaning: Section 151(c) applies because the subject is the claimant's dependent for the taxable year.

interface.name: deduction_under_151_allowable_to
interface.meaning: A deduction under section 151 with respect to the subject is allowable to the claimant for the claimant's taxable year.

interface.name: different
interface.meaning: The two expressly supplied persons are different; inequality is never inferred.

interface.name: section_151d1_applies
interface.meaning: The general section 151(d)(1) exemption-amount rule applies defeasibly to the subject and taxable year.

interface.name: section_151d2_applies
interface.meaning: Section 151(d)(2) applies because a section 151 deduction for the subject is allowable to a different taxpayer for a taxable year beginning in the calendar year in which the subject's taxable year begins.

interface.name: taxable_year_begins_in_2018_through_2025
interface.meaning: The taxable year begins after December 31, 2017, and before January 1, 2026; this factual period classification must be supplied explicitly.

interface.name: section_151d5_applies
interface.meaning: Section 151(d)(5) applies because the subject's taxable year begins after December 31, 2017, and before January 1, 2026.

interface.name: exemption_amount
interface.meaning: The final exemption amount applicable to the subject for the subject's taxable year; subject and taxable year form the key and amount is the output.

unresolved: The internal tests for qualifying-child and qualifying-relative status in section 152(c) and 152(d) are outside this local module; qualifying_child and qualifying_relative must therefore be supplied as signed facts.
Taxable-year-to-calendar-year alignment is factual and must be supplied through taxable_year_begins_in_calendar_year.
Whether a taxable year begins after December 31, 2017, and before January 1, 2026 is not computed arithmetically; taxable_year_begins_in_2018_through_2025 must be supplied as a factual relation.
Different-person status is never inferred; every required different pair must be supplied explicitly.
Sections 151(a), 151(b), 151(d)(3), 152(b)(2), 152(c), 152(d), and all other omitted subrules remain outside this requested local module.
Section 151(d)(1)'s exception for provisions other than the translated section 151(d)(2) and section 151(d)(5) rules remains unresolved.
